items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: Leo, do you remember that? Yeah, he plays, yeah. He played guitar. Yeah, he still plays. I put him in the union, too.

ctx.x: And some of these guys were walking in barricade carrying big buckets of rocks in each hand for a penance, man. You know they must have done something bad. What's the matter?

Leo, do you remember that? Yeah, he plays, yeah. He played guitar. Yeah, he still plays. I put him in the union, too. Yeah? I had my man on Uncle St. Charles. He played around the carnival with the guitar. Yeah? Who is it? Uncle Leo, yeah. Well, I swear. Joe was your Uncle too. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah, my Uncle wrote the words, that name. Angry?
Yeah. What's his name? What's your Uncle's name? Casson.
